newsitem.title: USA: Alpha Industries sees Q2 loss.
newsitem.headline: Alpha Industries sees Q2 loss.

text.p: Alpha Industries Inc said on Tuesday that it expects to report a second quarter net loss of about $0.45 to $0.49 a share, with net sales even with last year's level of $20.1 million.
The company also said it no longer expects fiscal 1997's operations to be profitable.

Alpha Industries cited lower than expected new orders for ceramic products and millimeter wave digital radio components, as well as reserves for excess inventory and a loss on a large filter order at the company's ceramics subsidiary.
The inventory write down and the loss on a filter order account for $1.9 million or $0.19 per share of the expected second quarter loss.
The net loss also includes the reversal of a $600,000 or $0.06 a share tax benefit recorded in the first quarter.
